# Matrix transpilation recipes rewrite imports only for the intended test environment

The owned README recipe uses rewriteImportExtensions outside NODE_ENV=test and a separate search-and-replace rule for the dynamic rust-crypto .ts import. Its comment explains that ordinary transpiled imports and Jest’s source imports need different extensions. A scoped build-maintenance recommendation is to update both paths when the SDK changes; the Babel/Jest recipe was read as documentation and was not executed or checked against live package versions. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: chat/protocols/matrix.
